# netcup_user_vlan (Resource)

The name of an existing VLAN of the netcup SCP user. netcup cannot create or delete VLANs through the API, so `destroy` only drops the resource from state. netcup answers with an error unless the server is in state SHUTOFF, so the provider sends no change if the name is already right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_user_vlan" "private" {
  vlan_id = 100
  name    = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VLAN.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth_class` (Attributes) Bandwidth class of the VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bandwidth_class))
- `id` (String) Equals `vlan_id`.
- `site` (Attributes) Site of the VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))
- `user` (Attributes) User the VLAN belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--bandwidth_class"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bandwidth_class`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Id of the class.
- `name` (String) Name of the class.
- `speed_in_mbit` (Number) Speed in MBit/s.


<a id="nestedatt--site"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City of the site.
- `id` (Number) Id of the site.
- `name` (String) Name of the site.


<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <vlan_id>
terraform import netcup_user_vlan.private 100
```
